clue.text: Creep spoils squabble for Spooner

indicators.note: Spooner's name says the opening sounds of the two words are to be exchanged

parts.note: spoils, the plunder taken, is loot
to squabble is to bicker

explanation.surface: A sneaky person ruins a quarrel, at least as the tongue-tied Reverend Spooner would put it.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the opening L and B of LOOT and BICKER.
explanation.definitionFit: A creep is a fawning flatterer, a toady who grovels to those above.

clue.text: Serbs essentially like president's mystical advisor

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its core, so the central letter of Serbs is taken

parts.note: as means like, in the way of
Vladimir Putin is the Russian president

explanation.surface: Serbian people are said to resemble a head of state's mystical counsellor.
explanation.walkthrough: Rasputin was the mystic who advised the last Russian tsar's family, so the Russian president fits the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Grigori Rasputin was the holy man and mystic who counselled Tsar Nicholas II's court.

clue.text: Rush Native Americans found crossing a river

indicators.note: the Cree straddle the letter, so it sits inside their name

parts.note: the Cree are a Native American people

explanation.surface: A tribe of Native Americans is found fording a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush headlong, out of control, is to career along.

clue.text: Watering hole provides refuge for European animal

indicators.note: a refuge shelters someone inside it, so the letter for European goes within the pub

parts.note: a watering hole is slang for a bar or pub

explanation.surface: A pub offers shelter to a creature from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Watering hole' suggests a place where animals drink, but here it is a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A bear is a large mammal, one example of an animal.

clue.text: Degree given to ex-president Ford's granny in Moscow

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree
George Bush, either of them, is a former US president
the Ka is a small car made by Ford

explanation.surface: A former president named Ford is given an honorary degree, along with his grandmother in Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ex-president Ford' reads as Gerald Ford; split it: Bush is the ex-president and Ford is the carmaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Babushka is the Russian word for a grandmother, also used of an old woman in a headscarf.

clue.text: Encounter AA Milne character, said to be a fireball

indicators.note: said tells us the joined words are spoken and then written as another word that sounds alike

parts.note: to encounter is to meet; Eeyore is the gloomy donkey in Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh stories

explanation.surface: Bumping into a Winnie-the-Pooh character turns out to be a blazing ball of fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A fireball is a bright shooting star burning up in the atmosphere.

clue.text: Composition to be handed in by end of August

parts.note: work that is due is owed and to be handed in

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter, here of August

explanation.surface: A piece of school work is set to be submitted by the end of August.
explanation.definitionFit: A duet is a musical piece written for two performers.

clue.text: A gentile's twisted spiritual practice

indicators.note: twisted round, the pieces face the other way and are read from the back

parts.note: goy is a Yiddish word for a gentile; the 's is read as is

explanation.surface: A non-Jewish person's warped spiritual discipline.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a Hindu discipline of meditation and postures aimed at spiritual union.

clue.text: Find the means

parts.note: reads as finding a way or resources, but means are arithmetic averages to be calculated

explanation.surface: Discover the method or wherewithal to do something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'means' looks like methods or money; here it is the statistical mean.
explanation.definitionFit: To calculate an arithmetic mean is to work out the typical value of a set of figures.

clue.text: Regularly sets back-to-back records in wilderness

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter, here the first and third of sets
back-to-back pairs a word with its own mirror image, so the record reads one way and then the other

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record; two of them placed back to back

explanation.surface: A sequence of records played one after another, again and again, out in the wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-to-back' puts EP against its mirror PE, the two records joined spine to spine.
explanation.definitionFit: A steppe is a vast treeless grassland plain, an uncultivated wild expanse.

clue.text: Risky game allowed in road

indicators.note: in places the word for allowed inside the word for road

parts.note: a route is a road or way
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A dangerous game is permitted on the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is the casino gambling game of a spinning wheel and ball, a game of chance.

clue.text: Plant is a write-off

indicators.note: off means wrong or awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plant is declared a total loss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'write-off' is one word on the surface; split it, so 'off' acts on IS A WRITE.
explanation.definitionFit: Wisteria is a climbing shrub with hanging clusters of lilac flowers.

clue.text: Sound analysts use device originally deployed on satellite

indicators.note: originally points to the beginnings, the first letters of the three words

parts.note: Io is a moon of Jupiter, a natural satellite

explanation.surface: Analysts use a gadget first launched on a satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio is the sound part of a recording or broadcast.

clue.text: As a result of this unorthodoxy, son becomes bishop

indicators.note: becomes means one letter changes into another

parts.note: heresy is a belief at odds with orthodox teaching
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A son's unorthodox views lead him to become a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereby is a formal adverb meaning by means of this document or act.

clue.text: An IRA man's overheads?

parts.note: overheads look like business costs, but they are things worn over the head, a terrorist's face covering

explanation.surface: The running costs of a paramilitary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overheads' suggests expenses; read it as headgear pulled over the face.
explanation.definitionFit: These are knitted woollen hoods covering the whole head except the eyes, associated with paramilitaries.

clue.text: Like a child, say

parts.note: a child is one example of kin, a relative; say marks the example

explanation.surface: Resembling a youngster, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: Akin means similar or related in character, as in alike.

clue.text: Oscar, consumed by infection, takes vitamin-A drink

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside, so the infection surrounds the letter

parts.note: VD stands for venereal disease, an infection
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet
K is a vitamin, involved in blood clotting

explanation.surface: A man named Oscar, laid low by an infection, has a vitamin drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Vodka is a clear distilled spirit, an alcoholic beverage from Russia and Poland.

clue.text: Dismissed rises in cause of disease for good

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside the cause of disease

parts.note: a virus is a microbe that causes disease

indicators.note: rises in a down clue means read from the bottom up

parts.note: a batter who is dismissed is out, in cricket

explanation.surface: A rejected rise in the source of an illness, for the benefit of all.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rises' means read upwards; 'Dismissed' is the cricket sense, a batter given out.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtuous describes someone of high moral standards, upright and righteous.

clue.text: Toy with Liberal following party line

indicators.note: following puts the letter for Liberal after the word for party

parts.note: a do is a party or social event

explanation.surface: Play with a Liberal following the party line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toy with' looks like a verb phrase; Toy is the noun definition and 'with' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A doll is a child's plaything in the form of a small human figure.

clue.text: Control weird sect delivering different kinds of speech

parts.note: a dial is a control knob on a device

indicators.note: weird means strange, out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Taking charge of a strange religious group that speaks in tongues.
explanation.definitionFit: Regional varieties of a language, each with its own words and pronunciation.

clue.text: Video ref accepts concerns? Initial reaction is shock!

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so the word for concerns goes inside

parts.note: TMO, the television match official, is rugby's video referee
re means concerning or about

indicators.note: initial means the first letter, here of reaction

explanation.surface: A video referee takes up complaints, and the first response is outrage.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a shaking, as of the earth in a minor earthquake.

clue.text: Capital way to operate barge

parts.note: MO, modus operandi, is a way of operating
a scow is a flat-bottomed barge

explanation.surface: A method for steering a cargo boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Moscow is the capital city of Russia.

clue.text: Old tree houses soldier turned over to member of elite

indicators.note: houses means contains, so the tree holds the soldier inside it

parts.note: the larch is a conifer tree

indicators.note: turned over means flipped round, read backwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: An ancient tree shelters a soldier who defected to the ruling class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' flips the soldier, and 'houses' sets the result inside the tree; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An oligarch is one of a small ruling group, especially a wealthy Russian business magnate.

clue.text: Fixed location of camper

definitions.meaning: fixed in purpose, as in being set on something, determined
a camper sleeps inside canvas: in a tent

explanation.surface: The settled position of someone camping.
explanation.definitionFit: Being intent on a goal means being fixed upon it, firmly resolved.

clue.text: Papers written by head of university about stress

parts.note: the press means the newspapers

indicators.note: the head is the first letter, here of university

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Newspapers carry an article by a university chief about strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressure is strain or stress, physical or mental.

clue.text: Sound of genuine dance music

indicators.note: sound of means the word for genuine is heard and written as another of the same sound

parts.note: genuine means real

explanation.surface: The noise of authentic music for dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is a lively Scottish or Irish folk dance, and the tune played for it.

clue.text: Classic movie about detective gets rewrite

indicators.note: about means around, so the film's letters go round the detective

parts.note: ET is Spielberg's classic 1982 film
DI is a detective inspector

explanation.surface: An old film about a detective gets revised.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit is to revise and correct text before publication.

clue.text: Perform boring operation

parts.note: boring looks like tedious, but it means drilling a hole, here in the skull

explanation.surface: Carry out a dull surgical procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons drill a hole in the skull with a cylindrical saw, an ancient surgical practice.

clue.text: A Spin Doctor live on tour

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with or alter, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A political spin doctor performs live while touring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spin Doctor' reads as one phrase; split it, so 'A Spin' is the definition and 'Doctor' the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolution is one complete turn of a wheel or body about its axis.

clue.text: Dreaded individual almost returned as leader

indicators.note: returned means sent back, read from right to left
almost means not quite complete, so the final letter goes

parts.note: a Rastafarian, or Rasta, typically wears dreadlocks

explanation.surface: A feared person nearly came back as the ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreaded' looks like feared, but means wearing dreadlocks; 'almost' cuts RASTA to RAST, which 'returned' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsar was the emperor of Russia, the supreme ruler.
